scope: Repository-reconstructable E1 ReasoningBank Ark Plan model-call receipts only; not an account-level Ark billing export.

afp_equivalent_reference.warning: This is a mechanical AFP-equivalent reconstruction from repository token receipts and the displayed DeepSeek V4 Pro coefficient. It is not the official account-level AFP Used field returned by GetAFPUsage/GetUsageDetails and must not be presented as an exact billing receipt.

account_level_boundary.reason: The repository has the Agent Plan model API key path used for inference, but no stored HMAC control-plane GetAFPUsage/GetUsageDetails export. Account-level historical AFP may include calls outside these E1 receipt directories.
account_level_boundary.display_rule: Label repository reconstruction as a lower bound and AFP-equivalent, never as exact account AFP usage.
